verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships a dedicated `writing-skills` meta-skill that walks the agent through authoring a new skill as TDD for process docs: write pressure-scenario tests, watch them fail, write the skill, watch them pass, then refactor (docs-15, docs-76, docs-62, docs-50). It also documents where skills live across runtimes (`~/.agents/skills/`, docs-31). The runtime probe confirms skills are plain markdown folders with SKILL.md frontmatter that install cleanly, and an evals harness judges skill compliance (probe-rt-1, docs-14). Missing for 10: explicit documented steps for packaging or publishing a newly authored skill into the plugin or marketplace, and independent or hands-on evidence of an agent authoring a skill end to end.
